commands.label: Execute native consumer and assert the example result

check.py.content_utf8:
from pathlib import Path
import asyncio
from importlib.metadata import version
import lummao
q=lummao.compile_script(Path("hello.lsl").read_bytes())
messages=[]
q.builtin_funcs["llOwnerSay"] = messages.append
asyncio.run(q.execute())
assert messages==["Hello, World!"],messages
print(messages[0])
print("Lummao",version("lummao"))

reproduction_command: Compile hello.lsl with Lummao, execute its state machine and capture llOwnerSay locally
semantic_scope: The Lummao LSL compiler and runtime processed the original state_entry event. A local llOwnerSay capture received precisely one greeting.
path_normalization: Temporary paths use stable placeholders. Source hashes refer to the repository files listed in artifact_sha256.
